verdict.rationale: Data export is a fair question for an AI assistant and coding product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents exporting conversations, memories, files or account data in open formats, or any account-exit or portability path. The Admin API queries billing, usage and audit logs, and the files API handles uploads; both are adjacent features, not a user data-export capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
